tier_0.name: Hard Security Invariants & Self-Protection
tier_0.enforcement: Deterministic, zero ML, non-negotiable compile-time & static checks
tier_0.scope: Destructive system operations (rm -rf /, disk wipes, fork bombs) and protection of engine files/configs

tier_1.name: Deterministic Fast-Path with Permission Validation
tier_1.enforcement: Strict read-only whitelist and declarative regex rules with verified path containment
tier_1.scope: view_file, read_file, search_files, grep, safe read-only commands

tier_2.name: Neural Risk Assessment
tier_2.enforcement: Calibrated ModernBERT ONNX inference acting as advisory risk evidence
tier_2.scope: Mutating commands, scripts, writes, complex actions; fails closed to REQUIRE_AUTHORIZATION on uncertainty

tier_3.name: Execution Enforcement, Sandboxing & Audit Logging
tier_3.enforcement: Host interceptors, sandbox confinement, and immutable structured audit trail
tier_3.scope: PreToolUse/PostToolUse protocol enforcement across Antigravity, Cursor, and Claude Code
